text:
maria_supp: heads up — ACME reported major latency regression after a small deploy around 17:20 UTC. p95 jumped from ~2.3s to ~9.8s, p99 from ~6s to ~28s. customer sees a lot of 504s and long tail. request backlog grew to ~1200.
maria_supp: sample request id: rq_acme_20260317_01. tenant: acme-enterprise. repro curl attached below.
maria_supp: ```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" -H \"x-request-id: rq_acme_20260317_01\" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate``` 
jake_oncall: thanks. I’m pulling recent metrics — admission_control.waitlist length and ingress.queue_depth. tagging @sam_runtime and @iris_sre. will confirm whether autoscaler reacted.
jake_oncall: can someone check worker OOMs/GC, KV cache evictions, and host cpu on embed workers? those symptoms match ringbuffer/worker-saturation.
sam_runtime: looking now — I see sustained CPU at ~94% on embed-node-pool-3 starting 17:18. per-host queue length climbed and kube HPA failed to scale for ~4 minutes (scale loop errors). KV cache eviction rate spiked ~17:22 which increased cold-starts and amplified latency.
iris_sre: I also see admission controller lowering admit rate (we hit concurrency limit) and many inflight requests are stuck in prefix-queue. p95/p99 escalation matches.
deploy-bot: [autoscaler] 2026-03-17T17:21:12Z ERROR: failed to call cloudapi.ScaleUp: rate limit 429
jake_oncall: autoscaler 429 — cloud provider rate limits may have prevented scaling. fallback not configured for this pool. we should open a short-term mitigation.
sam_runtime: immediate mitigations I suggest:
- temporarily increase admission_control.max_concurrency for acme-enterprise to allow higher concurrency (for a few minutes) OR enable bypass for enterprise tier
- spin up 2 warm nodes in embed-node-pool-3 (manual scale) with image pull/ready hooks
- reduce non-critical background work (batching jobs) on those nodes
- enable KV cache warmup script for tenant acme-enterprise
iris_sre: agree. also recommend applying a 5m canary restart of 2 pods in the pool to clear bad state (restart one at a time). that should reduce queueing head-of-line blocking if some worker threads are stuck.
maria_supp: customer wants ETA. can we give a 20–30m mitigation window? they can accept short-term concurrency bump.
jake_oncall: I’ll do manual node scale + admission bump now. running:
```kubectl scale --replicas=12 deployment/embed-worker-pool-3 -n prod
# then
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/adm-control/acme-enterprise?action=update&max_concurrency=80 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ops-token'
```
sam_runtime: kalau — after scaling I’ll watch cold-start rates and KV eviction. if p99 remains high, we should route acme traffic to node-pool-5 (less loaded) via routing override.
iris_sre: temporary global throttle on free-tier/unknown-tenant traffic would buy room. can someone flip the low-priority policy? it’s feature flag: rollout.low_prio_throttle = true
deploy-bot: [ops] 2026-03-17T17:26:05Z ACTION: scaled embed-worker-pool-3 to 12 replicas (manual)
sam_runtime: seeing immediate drop in queue depth from 1200 -> ~300 over 2m, KV eviction rate decreasing. p95 trending down to ~3.1s, p99 down to ~9s.
maria_supp: great — notifying ACME now. ACME rep @acme_cs: passing update — we scaled and applied short-term concurrency increase, working on routing if needed.
acme_cs: thanks Maria. customer asking for root cause and ETA for permanent fix. they saw high traffic spike but said volume was within their usual 95th percentile.
jake_oncall: next steps:
- follow-up on autoscaler 429 errors with infra (cloud quotas) — ticket created (INFRA-7892)
- implement fallback autoscaling path for embed pools (hot spare pool)
- add tenant-aware warmup for KV cache on scale events
- add alert for sustained kv_eviction_rate > threshold at 5m
maria_supp: I’ll keep this thread updated and record timeline for ACME postmortem. marking customer as P1 until metrics are stable.
iris_sre: if we see recur, plan is to cut non-critical green traffic and enforce fairness at ingress. for now, monitor 30m after p99 < 5s before fully closing.
maria_supp: closing loop: p95 ~2.8s, p99 ~6.7s at 17:39 UTC. keeping monitoring for 30m.
